g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Inflow percentage of a metro area is measured as the number of people in the cohort who moved from elsewhere as a share of the number who grew up there.Outflow is the share of people who grew up there who now live somewhere else. Metro areas with higher inflow than outflow have a positive percentage change in population.'

text.tspan: Inflow percentage of a metro area is measured as the number of people in the cohort who moved from elsewhere
as a share of the number who grew up there.Outflow is the share of people who grew up there who now live
somewhere else. Metro areas with higher inflow than outflow have a positive percentage change in population.
